name: Blind ROP (BROP) over network service without binary source
topic: Blind ROP (BROP) over network service without binary source
description: Blind ROP (BROP) over network service without binary source -- a insane-tier binary exploitation challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Blind ROP (BROP) over network service without binary source"
Locate the encoded artifact (look in every shipped file)
Unwrap the encoding applied to the artifact
Recover the plaintext flag and submit it in pwn{...} format

hints.text: Start by inspecting every file in the bundle (hex dump, headers, magic bytes).
The artifact is wrapped in a non-text container -- use the right parser.
The artifact is layered: hex -> byte-reverse -> XOR with a 4-byte key. Recover the key with a known-plaintext crib.
